snippet.title: Node Crown - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Node Crown is a roguelite focused on building a node-based kingdom. Quick runs designed for replayability, deep synergies, hundreds of nodes, and builds that make every run unique - you will find it here!

Steam Page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4326740/Node_Crown/

Discord Server: https://discord.com/invite/sfgr7YCv2z

If you find the game interesting, I will be glad for your wishlist and leave a comment!

I am always open to feedback/discussion/suggestions, so feel free to make use of the comment section below. It helps a lot to make the game better!

Thank you in advance, and have a nice day!

About the game
The rules are simple - every few seconds, you can select 1 of 3 nodes and place it on the board. Nodes earn money, and your goal is to accumulate enough money before the time runs out. After that, you can select a super-special node that significantly improves your build and income, and start the next round up to the end of the run.

Each node is different. They can buff/destroy/trigger/etc other nodes or affect the game in general with various mechanics like increasing the board size, adding rerolls, spawning other nodes, and more.

All of them have tags, which in some cases will determine a faction such a node belongs to. I am designing tags/factions to let them work with all other factions. Ofc there are some more natural synergies, like Elves working very well with nodes of Nature and Elders, or Dwarves with Mining nodes. Even with that, there is no problem in (for example) investing in Elven/Dwarf/Goblin/Monster Warriors and boosting them with nodes that work well with a "WARRIOR" tag - creating a whole new build from factions that usually don't go along.
There are hundreds of nodes with different skills and tags. My main goal for Node Crown was to make it highly replayable, with a lot of possibilities, so builds and synergy are a core mechanic of the game.

The demo is a simpler roguelike "prologue" version of the game without metaprogression and with limited functionality, but for the full version I prepared a lot of fun:
- 12 additional "themed" crowns with new nodes and ways to play. Each of them has a few stages with increasing difficulty,
- +40 artifacts that passively affect the game,
- random in-game events,
- meta upgrades that allows to boost your nodes,
- a light detective story accompanying you through the game,
- a lot more node mechanics unlocked along with the new crowns that change the way you approach other nodes.

Have a nice day!
ByerN
